glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 攸 + semantic 木. Originally it indicates a small branch, perhaps with some reference to a wooden stick (in the top component, there is a man warned by a hand holding a vertical stick). The bottom part of the character is unrelated to 茶.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 條; s_page_origin explains the simplified 条.
